## Why visit

The strongest heritage anchor for a Southport beer day. Three panelled rooms, stained glass, fireplaces and surviving seating preserve a particularly engaging early-twentieth-century pub layout. Its broad cask offer means you do not have to choose between architectural interest and serious beer drinking. It complements Grasshopper’s cider focus and Tap & Bottles’ specialist range, and provides the most convincing reason to continue all the way into Southport if the smaller coastal stops already tempt you. It deserves an unhurried visit.
